criteria_description: Does the bank prohibit dedicated financing for thermal coal power plants?
criteria_guidelines: Covers explicit exclusions of project-specific financing for new coal power plants or expansions of existing ones. Dedicated financing includes project finance, direct loans, and other transactions with a clearly defined use of proceeds. General corporate financing is not included, unless the funds are explicitly earmarked for coal power projects.
criteria_examples:
Examples of evidence that would satisfy this criteria: - "The bank will not finance new projects for the construction of new thermal coal-fired power plants or for the expansion of an existing thermal coal-fired power plant." - "The bank does not provide financial products and services to new coal-fired power plant projects, as well as to brownfield retrofit coal-fired power plant projects." - "The bank will not assume any credit risk involving specific projects to build, develop or expand coal power plants."
- Examples of evidence that would NOT satisfy this criteria:"The bank will not finance clients that generate revenues from thermal coal-fired power generation." - "The bank will not finance clients that are involved in thermal coal expansion."
